title: Fuobe Cinema · shot lists
description: Short films as shot lists: each shot is its own clip with the same seed, so a recipe's adherence (CLIP per shot), flicker (temporal) and continuity across shots (CLIP image similarity between the shots) can be compared. Cloud runs on LTX 2.5 (open weights, hosted) until O6's fuobe-cinema exists; the partner variant runs Seedance 2.5 for reference.

original.description: The Cinema Original (or today's open / hosted-open model)

shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a lighthouse on a rocky cliff at dusk, waves breaking below, the camera slowly pushes in
Medium shot inside the lighthouse: an old keeper in a wool sweater climbs the spiral stairs holding a lantern, warm light
Close-up of the keeper's face lit by the turning lamp, he looks out to sea, the beam sweeps across the dark water
Handheld tracking shot of a courier in a yellow jacket running across wet rooftops at night, neon below
Low angle: the courier leaps the gap between two buildings, slow motion, rain in the air
Wide shot from above as the courier lands and rolls on the next roof, the city glowing behind
